Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Alok Kumar Mishra, holding brief of Sri Sunil Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant,
Sri Sri Niwas Bajpai, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 330 of 2022, under Sections 342, 376 IPC and 5M/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, Police Station Bihar, District Unnao.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. This case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 11.10.2022 at 09:36 hrs against the applicant and an unknown person, alleging that on 06.10.2022, while the informant's daughters aged about 12 and 9 years had gone to ease themselves between 07.00 to 07.30 p.m., the accused persons took away the informant's elder daughter.
His younger daughter came home and told about the incident and thereafter a search was carried out.
After about one hour, the villagers found the applicant in a naked condition with intention of committing a misdeed near a pond near the village.

4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C, she stated that the applicant had disrobed her and was teasing her; that meanwhile she switched on her torch, upon seeing Hori Lal Alias Shivam vs State Of U.P. entities.text: Hori Lal Alias Shivam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She categorically stated that apart from disrobing and teasing, no other misdeed was committed with her.
5. In the medico legal examination report of the victim no abnormality has been reported.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated certain additional facts which had not been stated by her also and she stated that her mother reached the place of occurrence and her mother had switched on a torch whereupon the applicant tried to run away.
6.
In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he is no previous criminal history.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that there are some contradiction in the version given in the FIR and the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 27.12.2022 and without making any observation which may affect the merit of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
